content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the šiauliai district court the court has made a final decision regarding the division of matrimonial property the applicant js is seeking a divorce from the defendant vs and wants to retain their married name and the defendants surname they also want to declare an apartment acquired during the marriage as their personal property the court has determined that the apartment basement belongs to the applicant as personal property the court has also ordered the defendant to pay the costs of the proceedings the court has declared that the immovable property belongs to the applicant and has ordered the state to pay the defendant the cost of sending procedural documents was 1344 euros
